checks.name: Real 1. A companion household plays days 1 to 3 by real actions: basket and jollof, housewarming, seedling, a fish for Mama Nkechi, catches sold, the armchair on the veranda, the harvest, deliveries, paint, the veranda evening, three ratings and both day-3 answers

Real 2. The copy button’s text keeps the first-evening timeline and the readable days, and ends with a CD35/1 data block whose length and check value hold and whose records equal S.life.days exactly; with no clipboard the page that shows it is titled “Timeline and days”
Real 3. Privacy: the days part and its block hold only the log (times, minutes, ratings, events) and the two typed answers; no player name, household name or save field beyond the day records

Real 4. The gates tool reads both sittings of one tester (merged by day) and its values equal the log: times to the millisecond, minutes, ratings, answers, the first catch after the first at-rocks, the day-3 evening, and the day-3 return taken from the Continue because the copy on the morning page woke day 3
Real 5. Without the block (an older build’s paste) the readable lines give the same times, ratings, answers and events, with minutes to 0.1 and a note saying so
Real 6. The command line: two files of one tester, the plain report and --json agree with the module; exit code 0; an unreadable file gives a message and exit code 2
Synthetic 1. Five testers who meet every gate (texts written by the real daysText35) give PASS on all seven, and the table carries each tester
Synthetic gate 1. Four of five slept on day 2 with “Coached: no” passes; three fails; a coached finisher fails; finishers without the reviewer’s note stay NOT YET, with the log’s count said

Synthetic gate 2. Day 3 started exactly 48 h after day-2 Sleep passes and 48 h plus one second fails; a morning-page copy that woke day 3 is read by the Continue that followed (47 h passes, 49 h fails), also when the morning page saw a tap that was logged (watering) before the tester left; a pause logged after two minutes of day-3 play is not the return, but a return after a morning-page copy counts however long the morning pages took; in the shipped runtime, a copy on the day-3 morning page and a tap in the same tab 47 h or 49 h after Sleep (no reload, no Continue) logs a resume and is read as the return (passes, fails); not back after 49 h by the copy time fails; not back yet is NOT YET
Synthetic gate 3. Day-3 mean equal to day 1’s with exactly three top faces passes; two top faces fails; a day-3 mean one step below day 1’s fails
Synthetic gate 4. Both answers from every tester pass (a four-letter word counts); “nothing”, a blank answer or a three-letter word fails, and the report quotes the answers
Synthetic gate 5. A median real day of exactly 20:00 or exactly 35:00 passes; 19:59 and 35:01 fail; the median, not the mean, is used
Synthetic gate 6. Four of five seeing the veranda evening on day 3 passes; three fails, and an evening first seen on day 4 does not count

Synthetic gate 7. A first catch 2:00 of play after first reaching the rocks passes and 2:01 fails, also across a night (rocks near the end of day 1, the catch on day 2); a catch logged before any at-rocks is set aside with a note
Synthetic 9. In progress (no --final): three testers part-way through day 2 and two not pasted yet give NOT YET on every gate, with the missing testers named in the notes
Paste 1. An online household: the copy button gives only “No first-evening timeline yet.” (no day log online); the tool says so and still reports

warnings: sitting 1: only the first-evening timeline, no days: an online household, or a copy from before v35
no day log: play the test in a single-player or companion household (online play keeps no log)

checks.name: Paste 2. Only the first-evening timeline (no days part): reported as a timeline without days, nothing invented

Paste 3. Cut short inside the data block: the block is reported cut (characters held of the total) and the readable lines are used; cut inside the days: the days read so far are kept, the broken line is named

Paste 4. An altered block (one character changed) fails its check value and falls back to the readable lines; an e-mail-quoted, CRLF paste reads the same as the original; empty or unrelated text says it is not a Compound Days copy

info.altered: sitting 1: the data block does not match its check value; read from the readable lines instead (minutes to 0.1)

checks.name: Paste 5. Two sittings that disagree on a day’s start (two households or devices) are flagged; several testers in one file split at their Tester lines; a sitting number in the file name merges sittings
Report hygiene: no report names a weekday or shows undefined or NaN, and the same pastes give the same report twice (no wall clock)

method: Actual shipped runtime with every v35 module in Node; a companion household driven by dispatch of real actions and the real tick functions, the copy taken from the real Menu copy button, then read by tools/gates-v35.cjs (as a module and on the command line). Synthetic testers are written by the real daysText35 from built records. The wall clock is stubbed through CLOCK35.
